title: {{name}} setup

stepIntros.company: The legal entity operating the venue, which will be invoiced.
stepIntros.venue: What your guests will see on the online booking page.
stepIntros.hours: When the spa welcomes guests, and planned closures.
stepIntros.rooms: One row per cabin or treatment room.
stepIntros.amenities: Only if you want these facilities to be bookable.
stepIntros.finance: Currency, VAT and who receives invoices.
stepIntros.pms: To charge treatments to your guests' room bill.
stepIntros.team: People who will access the management space and receive notifications (new bookings, cancellations…).
stepIntros.branding: So online booking matches your brand.

nav.shareHint: Your answers are saved at each step. You can come back later or share this link with a colleague.

errors.endAfterStart: End time must be after start time
errors.locked: This form has already been submitted and can no longer be edited.

upload.logoHint: PNG or JPG, ideally with a transparent background
upload.coverHint: High-resolution landscape photo (at least 2000 px wide)

invalid.title: Invalid link
invalid.text: This setup link does not exist. Check it or contact your account manager.

expired.title: Link expired
expired.text: This setup link is no longer active. Contact your account manager to get a new one.

submitted.title: Thank you, it's sent!
submitted.text: We have received the details for {{name}}. Our team is reviewing them and will get back to you for the go-live.

company.sirenHint: Enter it and click Search: we fill in the rest automatically.
company.lookupNotFound: No company found for this SIREN
company.lookupFailed: Search failed, please fill in manually
company.commercialNameHint: The name shown to your guests.
company.billingAddressHint: If different from the registered office.

venue.name: Venue name
venue.typeHotelHint: Spa inside a hotel, room charge available
venue.presentationDesc: Shown on the online booking page.
venue.subtitle: Welcome tagline
venue.subtitleHint: One line, below the venue name.
venue.timezoneHint: Derived from the country if left empty.
venue.accessHint: Floor, entrance, parking, changing rooms… Included in guest emails.

hours.closingHint: End time of the last treatment.
hours.closuresDesc: Lunch break, weekly closure or annual holidays. For a full day, enter 00:00 – 23:59.
hours.closureDateHint: Leave empty for a recurring closure.

amenities.intro: Turn on the facilities your guests can book.
amenities.exclusiveHint: Only one group at a time per slot.

booking.noticeHint: Guests cannot book later than this.
booking.turnoverHint: Time needed to reset a room.
booking.autoValidateHint: A booking is confirmed without your team's action.
booking.preAuthHint: Card saved, charged after the treatment.
booking.cancelCutoffHint: After this, guests can no longer cancel on their own.
booking.rescheduleCutoffHint: After this, guests can no longer move their appointment.
booking.tiersHint: Without tiers, a timely cancellation is refunded in full.

finance.commissionHint: As per your contract. Leave empty if unsure.
finance.ownEntity: The venue invoices under a different entity
finance.ownEntityHint: If the venue has its own company name or billing address.

payment.noSecrets: Never enter passwords, API keys or technical credentials here: we will set up these connections with you securely.
payment.laterTitle: Nothing to do here for now 🙂
payment.laterText: Online payment is connected from your admin space once your venue is created: in 2 clicks, with your Stripe account.

pms.roomCharge: Charge treatments to the room bill
pms.roomChargeHint: The amount is added automatically to the stay invoice.
pms.guestLookupHint: Name and details retrieved from the PMS.
pms.contactDesc: We will arrange access with them.

team.intro: Each person will receive an email invitation once your venue is approved.

branding.colorsDesc: Applied to the online booking page.
branding.fontsDesc: Optional: if your brand guidelines require specific fonts.
branding.notesHint: Any useful information: parking, robes, minimum age, contraindications…

summary.intro: Check that each step is complete, then send your answers.
summary.submitIntro: Once sent, your answers can no longer be edited. Our team reviews them before the go-live.
summary.confirmText: You will no longer be able to edit them. If something is wrong, contact your account manager.

requiredLegend: Required field. Everything else is optional: fill in what you know, you can come back later.

welcome.title: Let's set up {{name}} together
welcome.intro: This form lets us prepare your online booking space: company details, opening hours, treatment rooms, booking rules, team and visual identity. You fill it in, we review it, then we put your venue online.
welcome.timeText: Only a few fields are required, they are marked with an asterisk.
welcome.saveText: You can stop and come back later with this same link.
welcome.shareText: Forward the link to a colleague (finance, IT) so they can fill in their part.

prepare.siren: The company's SIREN number (the rest fills itself in)
prepare.visuals: Your logo and a nice photo of the venue
prepare.hours: Your opening hours and planned closures
prepare.rooms: The list of your treatment rooms
prepare.team: Contact details of the people who will manage bookings

welcome.helpText: Our team answers quickly by email.
welcome.resume: Pick up where I left off
